description: The University of Melbourne coastal-flood team publishes global extreme sea levels, inundation areas and associated socioeconomic impacts for present conditions, 2050 and 2100. The release combines storm surge, tides, wave setup and relative sea-level rise, then estimates expected annual population affected and damage under existing defences and two adaptation scenarios. Figshare identifies a public ZIP archive under CC BY 4.0, with data also described through a GIS viewing platform. These global outputs can screen coastal infrastructure exposure and compare adaptation simulations. They provide a first-pass assessment, whose resolution and defence assumptions mean local engineering interpretation is limited. Internal archive formats were not inspected. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Global Dataset of Extreme Sea Levels and Coastal Flood Impacts over the 21st Century
